papers.title_en: Communication-Efficient Clustered Federated Learning in Non-IID Wireless Networks
papers.authors: Martin Isaksson, Rickard Cöster, Šarūnas Girdzijauskas, Seif Haridi
papers.evidence: 面向非独立同分布数据的通信高效联邦分布式训练
papers.tldr: 面向6G无线环境中客户端数据非独立同分布导致传统联邦学习精度下降、通信开销高的问题，论文提出聚类联邦学习框架：先按数据域聚类初始化，再进行基于模型的客户端分群与专用模型训练。该方法无需共享原始数据，并适配不同类型的异质性。在DeepMIMO上较IFCA提升4.8个百分点，在FEMNIST上提升10.6个百分点且下行数据量减少83.1%，证明可兼顾性能与资源效率。
papers.abstract_en: Current and emerging mobile networks face increasing privacy, scalability, and performance challenges as distributed learning becomes essential for advanced 6G services. These challenges are amplified by the presence of non-IID data, naturally arising in heterogeneous wireless environments, that degrade the performance of standard Federated Learning (FL) approaches. To address non-IID data across clients, we propose a Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) framework that assigns clients to specialized models during training. Data-domain clustering initializes model-based clustering, enabling identification and exploitation of client similarities without sharing raw data while reducing communication cost.   Motivated by mmWave beam selection, we evaluate our methods on a wireless simulation dataset (DeepMIMO) and complement it with two non-IID benchmarks (FEMNIST, Rotated CIFAR-10) to isolate different non-IID characteristics. Our best configurations improve accuracy over IFCA by 4.8 pp on DeepMIMO and 10.6 pp on FEMNIST while reducing downlink data volume by 83.1 % on FEMNIST compared to IFCA.   We demonstrate that different clustering strategies suit different non-IID characteristics. These results show that our CFL methods enable resource-efficient, and high-performance distributed learning in future 6G networks.

papers.title_en: IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings
papers.authors: Konstantinos Stavrakakis, Ilgaz Er, Theofilos Spyrou, Dimitrios Stavrakakis, Stephan Wong, Georgi Gaydadjiev, Said Hamdioui
papers.evidence: 面向约束的深度神经网络加速器映射优化
papers.tldr: 深度神经网络加速器的映射需同时决定分块、存储层次顺序和并行方式，组合空间巨大，绝大多数候选还会违反硬件约束或造成利用率不足。IMPACT以遗传算法遍历完整空间，并用约束感知修复算子将不可行映射改造成可行解，而非直接丢弃。在灵活加速器的全部DeepBench任务上，它均优于现有方法；在约束苛刻的存内计算平台上，较最强基线将EDP、时延和能耗分别降低66%、47%和18%。该方法兼顾全空间探索与约束满足，可自动逼近专家手工映射。
papers.abstract_en: The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, and rivals hand-crafted expert mappings. Across flexible and highly constrained accelerators, IMPACT finds efficient mappings automatically. IMPACT will be released as open source.

papers.title_en: PDScope: Breaking the Prefill-Decode Seesaw for Memory-Bound MoE Inference
papers.authors: Enda Yu, Dezun Dong, Zhaoning Zhang, Xiaojian Yang, Weiling Yang, Shaonan Ma, Dongsheng Li, Yongwei Wu, Xiangke Liao
papers.evidence: 面向混合专家大模型服务的CPU-GPU内存与调度优化
papers.tldr: 在本地 CPU-GPU 节点部署 MoE 大模型时，显存不足使多数专家驻留 CPU；低批量场景中，预填充偏计算密集、解码偏 PCIe I/O 密集，统一调度会在两阶段间顾此失彼。PDScope 利用分阶段可预测的专家路由，分别进行激活预测、放置与预取，并以跨层成本模型制定策略。系统通过静态计算图、缓存预取和零拷贝异步 I/O 消除执行开销。在主流 MoE 模型上，其预填充和解码吞吐分别提升 2.5–10.3 倍与 2.1–6.1 倍，证明相位感知协同设计可突破受限显存下的推理瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Local deployment of MoE-based LLMs on CPU-GPU nodes is attractive for cost and privacy reasons, yet limited GPU memory forces most experts into CPU memory. Prefill is then compute-bound and benefits from aggressive GPU loading, while decode is I/O-bound and requires conservative PCIe transfers. These demands cannot be amortized under low batching---typical of local assistants and document tools---forcing phase-agnostic schedulers into a seesaw: favoring prefill's aggressive loading injects unmaskable I/O that stalls decode, while favoring decode's conservative transfers starves prefill's GPU of work. We observe that expert routing is predictable in phase-specific ways, allowing us to decouple the two phases and optimize prediction, scheduling, and execution independently for each phase. PDScope predicts expert activations to guide placement and prefetching, adapts these policies to each phase's bottleneck via cross-layer cost modeling, and compiles decisions into overhead-free pipelines using a static computation graph, cache prefetching, and zero-copy asynchronous I/O. On mainstream MoE models, PDScope achieves 2.5-10.3x higher prefill throughput and 2.1-6.1x higher decode throughput than existing systems, showing that phase-aware co-design unlocks efficient MoE inference under memory constraints and extends naturally to multi-batch settings.

papers.title_en: When Does Heterogeneity Pay Off? Understanding GPU-WSE System Complementarity
papers.authors: Ziyu Hu, Zhijing Ye, Jiamin Wang, Zhiqing Zhong, Zhendong Mi, Shaoyi Huang, Weijian Zheng, Rajkumar Kettimuthu, Xiaodong Yu
papers.evidence: 异构GPU与晶圆级引擎系统性能建模
papers.tldr: 随着AI加速器架构日益多样化，将GPU与晶圆级引擎整合为统一系统成为新型异构计算范式，但二者在计算、存储和通信组织上的差异既带来互补性，也引入协同开销。论文提出分层基准测试方法，系统刻画GPU—晶圆级引擎异构执行行为，并构建解析性能模型。该模型用于辨识异构性何时会成为瓶颈、何时可转化为系统级性能收益。工作为异构加速器的任务划分、协同调度与系统设计提供了可量化的判断框架。
papers.abstract_en: As AI accelerator architectures become increasingly diverse, integrating different architectures into a unified system is emerging as a new heterogeneous computing paradigm. GPUs and WSEs differ substantially in compute, memory, and communication organization, creating both architectural complementarity and additional overheads, yet how to translate this heterogeneity into practical performance gains remains unclear. To address this gap, we propose a hierarchical benchmarking methodology to characterize GPU--WSE heterogeneous execution and the conditions for exploiting complementarity, together with an analytical performance model that identifies when heterogeneity becomes a bottleneck and when it yields system-level performance gains.

papers.title_en: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
papers.authors: Fatema Siddika, Abhijit Chunduru, Zilinghan Li, Ali Jannesari, Ravi Madduri
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的联邦持续学习框架
papers.tldr: 联邦持续学习需在不共享客户端数据、任务持续演进时保留旧知识；稀疏专家虽能局部适配，却因不同客户端专家内容不一致而难以安全聚合。FedSEAM通过任务感知瓦片选择与子空间兼容性测试，决定专家复用或扩容；服务端仅沿客户端达成一致的子空间方向合并更新。该方法还抑制路由漂移和合并擦除，并在TRACE上基于Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B开展组件及数据规模评测，为兼顾新任务学习与旧知识保持提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. We identify two remaining sources of forgetting, routing drift and merge erasure, and address them with three protections, one of which exactly preserves tile components in a selected prior-overlap subspace at every merge. We evaluate FedSEAM on TRACE using Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-3B, with component-wise ablations and studies of data size to assess its balance between learning new tasks and retaining prior knowledge.

papers.title_en: One-Shot Federated Model Editing for Device Dynamics at the Edge
papers.authors: Youming Tao, Weijun Yin, Huanyi Xie, Yanqing Yao, Dongxiao Yu, Xiuzhen Cheng, Di Wang, Falko Dressler
papers.evidence: 面向动态边缘客户端的联邦训练适配
papers.tldr: 传统联邦学习依赖多轮持续连接，难适应频繁上下线的车联网等边缘场景；一次式联邦学习虽只需单轮，却会因模型固化而无法处理后续新增或撤回的数据贡献。论文提出稳定一次式算法F-SOSA，以调参后的本地模型子采样实现稳定聚合，并用曲率感知融合保持效用。在此基础上构建遗忘与增量编辑，使结果及中间状态与重训统计不可区分，并以约O(ρ)成本获得接近重训性能、降低时间和通信开销。
papers.abstract_en: Standard federated learning (FL) requires persistent device connectivity across multiple communication rounds, making it unsuitable for dynamic environments such as vehicular networks, where devices frequently join and leave. One-shot FL offers a promising alternative by completing training in a single communication round. However, one-shot FL suffers from model solidification and cannot readily adapt to subsequent client dynamics, including new client contributions and the withdrawal of previous contributions. We therefore consider exact model editing, which removes withdrawn contributions through unlearning or incorporates newly contributed ones through incremental learning without retraining from scratch. We identify that efficient editing fundamentally hinges on learning stability. To this end, we propose F-SOSA, the first stable one-shot FL algorithm that enables rapid and exact model editing. F-SOSA leverages sub-sampling of local models with carefully tuned rate for stable aggregation and performs curvature-aware model fusion to preserve utility. We prove that F-SOSA achieves vanishing training error and reasonably small generalization error bounds. Building on this stability, we further develop two single-round editing algorithms: F-SOSA-U for unlearning and F-SOSA-I for incremental learning. They ensure that the edited model, along with all intermediate algorithmic states, is statistically indistinguishable from retraining while incurring only an expected $O(ρ)$ fraction of its cost, where $ρ$ quantifies stability. Experiments demonstrate that our approach matches retraining performance while reducing cumulative time and communication overhead by at least 36% and 22%, respectively, under realistic urban mobility simulations.

papers.title_en: DuplexTune: Coupled-State Replay for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Adaptation
papers.authors: Paul Raj, Simon Caldwell, Daniel Whitmore, Mutlu Mete
papers.evidence: 面向大模型训练的MoE显存优化方法
papers.tldr: 混合专家模型虽按需激活专家，但微调仍需保存大量中间状态，显存成为主要瓶颈。DuplexTune以双残差流间的可训练宽度桥接，重放穿过预训练注意力和专家模块的耦合隐藏状态；先预热桥接，再冻结路由器适配骨干。在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B单卡H800上，显存由64.8降至38.8GB、吞吐由19.9增至25.1样本/秒，并取得67.2% MMLU。工作还给出状态恢复的收敛与重放条件，揭示存储、速度、适配质量间的配置相关权衡，多语能力则较基线偏弱。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse expert execution does not remove the stored states needed to adapt a mixture-of-experts language model. We present DuplexTune, a framework for replaying coupled hidden states through pretrained attention and expert modules. Trainable width bridges connect two residual streams to the backbone. Bridge warm-up precedes backbone adaptation, with router weights kept frozen. We analyze the implicit state-recovery equation and identify the convergence and replay conditions needed for reconstruction. On Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, the single-H800 evaluation reports 38.8 GB peak memory, versus 64.8 GB for supervised fine-tuning with checkpointing, and throughput of 25.1 versus 19.9 samples/s. DuplexTune achieves 67.2% MMLU, 75.6% GSM8K, and 7.69 MT-Bench, with a weaker multilingual score than the checkpointed baseline. The results characterize a configuration-dependent tradeoff among state storage, throughput, and adaptation quality.

papers.authors: Jia Chen, Yecheng Lv, Xinrong Hu, Mingdi Huang, Jun Bai
papers.evidence: 分割联邦学习的分布式训练框架
papers.tldr: 分割联邦学习因客户端与服务器分段执行、双侧聚合，使历史贡献跨分区传播，现有联邦遗忘方法难以直接适用。论文首次系统定义分割联邦遗忘，覆盖按客户端/类别删除、反事实重训及分区更新约束。提出SURE，以双重重要性估计、选择性参数扰动和重要性引导恢复实现遗忘。实验显示其以适度额外开销取得接近对应重训的效果，并揭示切分位置和可更新范围决定遗忘—效用权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Split federated learning (SFL) combines partitioned model execution with federated aggregation to support collaborative learning across distributed Web and edge environments. However, removing learned contributions in SFL is challenging due to cross-partition coupling and historical influence propagation through dual-side aggregation. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first systematic formulation of Split Federated Unlearning (SFU), encompassing client-wise and class-wise removal, counterfactual retraining, and partition-specific update constraints. We theoretically characterize historical influence propagation and mode-dependent unlearning feasibility, revealing structural limitations of restricted model updates. As an initial solution, we propose SURE, integrating dual-importance estimation, selective parameter perturbation, and importance-guided recovery. Extensive experiments with existing unlearning methods adapted to SFL reveal substantial forgetting-utility trade-offs across model architectures, data distributions, and update modes. SURE achieves competitive agreement with mode-matched retraining at modest additional cost, while further analyses highlight the impact of split position and update constraints on unlearning behavior. These findings establish SFU as a distinct research problem and provide a foundation for unlearning in partitioned federated systems.

papers.title_en: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches
papers.evidence: 降低参数量与KV缓存内存的大模型架构
papers.tldr: 循环式 Transformer 通过重复使用权重以较少参数获得更深计算，但递归推理时共享缓存与并行训练所见缓存不一致，造成续算损失上升。本文提出 LSTM 风格循环 Transformer，在循环核心中共用一套键值缓存，并在训练预算最后10%加入两种前向缓存表征的一致性损失。1024宽度下参数减少40.4%、持久缓存组由15降至4；在 FineWeb 三种宽度上消除全缓存评估下续算损失惩罚的81%—89%。结果表明，低数据预算和存储受限时，权重绑定循环计算具有实用潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent transformers reuse weights to perform deep computation with fewer parameters. We study an LSTM-style transformer that also shares one key--value cache across its recurrent core. At width 1024, it uses 40.4% fewer parameters than an untied control at nearly matched forward FLOPs, and reduces persistent cache sets from fifteen to four. Parallel training supplies cache entries from a standard-attention pass, whereas continuation reads entries produced recursively using shared attention. We address this mismatch by aligning the two training passes' cache entries with a consistency loss during the final 10% of a fixed training-token budget. Across three model widths on FineWeb, this removes 81--89% of the continuation-loss penalty relative to full-cache evaluation. The improvement replicates on disjoint documents for two training seeds. Across four widths and 1.05--4.19B training tokens, the loss cost of weight tying is smallest at lower token budgets, suggesting an opportunity to use recurrent computation when data and model storage are limited.

papers.title_en: Adapting DNNs to Embrace Voltage Scaling Induced Errors via Accumulation-Aware Quantization
papers.authors: Alexis Maras, Panagiotis Chaidos, Georgios Alexandris, Dimitrios Soudris, Sotirios Xydis
papers.evidence: 面向节能DNN执行的软硬件协同设计
papers.tldr: 低电压缩放虽能显著降低DNN推理功耗，却会因时序违例、工艺波动和吞吐下降而损害可靠性。论文发现，脉动阵列累加器在不同电压—频率点具有不同的时序稳健位范围，并据此提出累加感知训练。该方法联合混合精度量化、非结构化剪枝、选择性高位屏蔽、细粒度时钟门控及逐层动态调频。在2纳米后布局评估中，低压边界下能耗和能耗—延迟积较标称电压分别降低39%与23%，精度损失控制在1%以内，为跨层协同容错降压提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: The pervasive deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) across the computing spectrum has brought growing attention to energy efficiency, alongside raw performance. While voltage scaling is a potent knob for power reduction, its application in next-generation nodes is hampered by severe throughput degradation and susceptibility to process variation. This work aims to address these energy-reliability trade-offs by introducing a hardware-software co-design methodology, based on the observation that timing-robust bit ranges within the accumulator of a systolic array vary significantly across different voltage-frequency operating points. At the software level, we propose an Accumulation-Aware Training approach that incorporates this information as a first-order optimization constraint during training. By integrating mixed-precision quantization with unstructured pruning, we effectively constrain the model's weight distribution to avoid activating the hardware's sensitized high-rank carry chains. At the architectural level, we complement this with selective MSB-masking and fine-grained clock-gating to minimize unnecessary dynamic switching activity. Furthermore, we employ a layer-wise Dynamic Frequency Scaling strategy to further adapt to the accumulator's reduced dynamic range, based on the numerical sensitivity of each layer. We experimentally evaluate the proposed solution on a deep scaled 2nm technology node and demonstrate that, when operating at a low-voltage frontier, our co-optimized post-layout architecture delivers substantial energy and energy-delay product gains of 39% and 23% respectively, relative to the nominal voltage implementation, while maintaining accuracy degradation within 1%.

papers.title_en: Task Relevance-Driven Prompt Expansion for Federated Continual Learning
papers.authors: Jiahua Dong, Wenqi Liang, Yang Cong, Yichen Li, Hongyuan Yu, Henghui Ding, Yulun Zhang, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
papers.evidence: 面向演化客户端任务的联邦持续学习
papers.tldr: 联邦持续学习中的客户端通常无法预知新任务何时到来及其类别数，且旧任务的无关语义会干扰新知识学习并加剧遗忘。TRPE先在本地以分布外检测发现任务切换，再由代理服务器利用半径自适应DBSCAN推断新类别数。方法通过比较原始梯度与其对旧特征空间正交后的梯度，估计全局任务相关性并筛选、拼接相关提示；同时施加软正交约束。多数据集、多骨干实验验证其有效性，说明该框架可在未知任务流下利用正向迁移并平衡稳定性与可塑性。
papers.abstract_en: Federated continual learning (FCL) has attracted considerable interest by enabling local clients to continually acquire knowledge from new tasks. However, most FCL methods assume that the global server has prior knowledge of the arrival times and number of categories for new tasks, which is unrealistic in the real world. Furthermore, they neglect the importance of positive inter-task semantic relationships when learning new tasks and are significantly affected by irrelevant relationships from old tasks, thereby exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To resolve the above challenges, we develop a novel Task Relevance-driven Prompt Expansion (TRPE) model. Specifically, to eliminate the reliance on prior knowledge of new tasks, we propose an out-of-distribution detector to identify the arrival of new tasks within local clients, along with a radius-adaptive DBSCAN to infer the quantity of categories in new tasks on the proxy server. Moreover, to explore positive inter-task relationships, we calculate the affinity between the original gradient for learning new task and its gradient orthogonal to the feature space of old tasks to evaluate semantic relevance between old and new tasks from a global perspective. Then, we use this global task relevance to determine the key-prompt pair for new tasks and identify highly related old tasks. After concatenating their prompts for training, we can leverage such positive inter-task relations to improve the continual learning of newly arriving tasks. To balance the learning of new tasks and the forgetting of old ones, a soft orthogonality constraint is applied to the local key and prompt gradients. Experiments spanning diverse datasets and backbones confirm the efficacy of our TRPE model.
